Caline Caline CP-xx series browse by type volume/amplification amplification preamp / clean boost browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive overdrive browse by enclosure pedal Caline CP-79 Wolf Pack / King Of Ga-Ga - Boost/Overdrive Published on January 9, 2020 Caline CP-xx series boost / preamp overdrive pedal Information Caline The Caline cp-79 overdrive pedal is inspired by the classic Tube screamer pedal, which adds a booster switch that provides clear and smooth tones. Tube screamer is a very powerful tone-shaping tool and an internal supply voltage step-up that allows more dynamic range and headroom with tight bass tones. It is also a great low to medium gain overdrive and great clean boost. This pedal truly simulates the smooth overload characteristics of a good vacuum tube amplifier. Features: Tube screamer based overdrive circuitry allows the pedal to realistically emulate the smooth overdrive characteristics of a good vacuum tube amp. With VOL, TRE, Gain and Boost control, the pedal is a low to medium overdrive and great clean boost. Overdrive/Boost footswitch for cutting off the extra low frequency to make tone cleaner. True bypass provides transparent tone, with LED light to indicate effect or bypass status. With aluminum alloy shell, durable and stable, exquisite and portable.
